findings.issue: Directive says 6 factions but Canon has 7.

findings.issue: Elite missions must differ meaningfully from Normal.
findings.resolution: Each Elite mission has secondary seal objective, different map emphasis, reinforcement changes, stricter timing, and boss/commander mechanic.
